issues.description: transform is silently skipped when value already comes in as a list from multiple instances
issues.detail: When the same param appears multiple times, items is already a list and the delimiter branch is bypassed. Fine. But the existing transform argument is applied later — verify it still runs on the post-split list. If a user passes delimiter plus transform, the per-element transform should apply uniformly. Worth a test; currently none of the new tests combine delimiter with transform.

issues.description: ValueError on bad delimiter leaks out instead of becoming HTTPBadRequest like the rest of the method
issues.detail: The docstring says ValueError from a transform becomes HTTPBadRequest. A bad delimiter is a programmer error, not a client error, so raising raw ValueError is arguably correct — but then the existing except-ValueError block around transform may swallow it depending on flow. Read the surrounding code and decide: programmer error should be loud and not caught. Document it explicitly.

issues.description: _PARAM_VALUE_DELIMITERS conflates user-facing symbolic names with the literal chars in one dict
issues.detail: Mixing 'pipeDelimited' and '|' as keys in the same mapping is cute but muddies the contract. Two small frozensets or a tiny normalize function would read better and keep the validation message honest. Not a blocker. Bad-taste-adjacent: the special case is the OpenAPI alias, and the code papers over it instead of naming it.

issues.description: blank/empty-token behavior after split is undefined and untested
issues.detail: What does get_param_as_list('x', delimiter=',') return for 'x=a,,b'? ['a','','b']? Empty string filtered? The keep_blank_qs_values note in the docstring says the option has no effect on secondary splitting, but no test pins the actual behavior. Pin it with one test so the next maintainer doesn't have to guess.

issues.description: no test for delimiter=None default path preserving existing behavior
issues.detail: The whole point of the change is that delimiter is opt-in and the default path is unchanged. Add one explicit test that calls get_param_as_list without delimiter on a comma-containing value with auto_parse_qs_csv False, asserting the value comes back as a single-element list. Cheap regression insurance.

review.summary: Small, well-scoped patch. One feature, one method, one new kwarg, overloads updated, news fragment included, tests cover the happy paths and the unsupported-delimiter case. This is the shape a patch should arrive in. NEEDS-WORK on a couple of items: the delimiter alias table mixes symbolic names with literal characters in one dict which is mildly bad taste, transform-plus-delimiter interaction is untested, blank-token behavior after split is undocumented and untested, and the default-path regression isn't pinned. Fix those and it lands.
